# agentplan Full Reference

## Data model and schema

agentplan is a CLI task-queue for AI agents to manage multi-session projects with tickets, dependency graphs, role-based routing, event hooks, and a dashboard control plane.
It is designed for terminal-native automation loops where multiple agents share one persistent queue.

Version: `0.5.0`

## Installation

```bash
pip install agentplan
```

## Runtime and storage

- Backend: SQLite (single file)
- DB defaults:
  - `AGENTPLAN_DIR=~/.agentplan`
  - `AGENTPLAN_DB=~/.agentplan/agentplan.db`
- Important env vars:
  - `AGENTPLAN_DIR`: directory that stores default DB
  - `AGENTPLAN_DB`: explicit DB path (overrides default path)

## Command index

```text
agentplan init
agentplan version
agentplan create <title> [--ticket <text> ...] [--notes <text>]
agentplan ticket add <project> <title> [--depends <id_csv>] [--priority high|medium|low] [--tag TAGS] [--due YYYY-MM-DD] [--desc TEXT]
agentplan ticket done <project> <ticket_id...> [--agent NAME] [--note TEXT]
agentplan ticket skip <project> <ticket_id...>
agentplan ticket start <project> <ticket_id> [--agent NAME]
agentplan ticket block <project> <ticket_id> [--reason TEXT]
agentplan ticket fail <project> <ticket_id> [--reason TEXT]
agentplan ticket review <project> <ticket_id> [--reason TEXT]
agentplan ticket edit <project> <ticket_id> [--title TEXT] [--priority ...] [--tag TAGS] [--due DATE]
agentplan ticket list <project> [--status pending|done|in-progress|blocked|failed|needs-review|skipped|all]
agentplan next [project] [--tag TAG]
agentplan claim <project> [--agent NAME] [--tag TAG] [--timeout MINUTES]
agentplan reap <project>
agentplan status [project] [--format compact|full|json]
agentplan list [--status active|completed|paused|abandoned|all]
agentplan attach <project> <label> <location> [--ticket <id>]
agentplan log <project> <entry> [--ticket <id>]
agentplan close <project> [--abandon]
agentplan archive <project>
agentplan note <project> <text> [--ticket <id>]
agentplan depend <project> <ticket_id> --on <id_csv>
agentplan undepend <project> <ticket_id> --on <id>
agentplan remove <project> [--ticket <id>]
agentplan search <query>
agentplan history <project> <ticket_id>
agentplan context <project>
agentplan role add <name> [--description TEXT]
agentplan role list
agentplan role remove <name>
agentplan role update <name> [--name NEW] [--description TEXT]
agentplan agent add <name> --command 'cmd {ticket}' --roles role1,role2 [--priority N]
agentplan agent list
agentplan agent remove <name>
agentplan agent update <name> [--command ...] [--roles ...] [--priority N]
agentplan route <project> <ticket_id> [--terminal] [--default-agent NAME]
agentplan hook add <project> --event on-complete --type command|webhook|chain --target '...'
agentplan hook list <project>
agentplan hook remove <project> <hook_id>
agentplan subtask add <project> <ticket_id> <title>
agentplan subtask done <project> <ticket_id> <subtask_id>
agentplan subtask list <project> <ticket_id>
agentplan chain <project> [--default-agent NAME]

agentplan auto-tag <project> <ticket_id>
agentplan dashboard [--port PORT] [--open] [--stop]
agentplan completion {bash|zsh|fish}
```

## Command details

### `agentplan init`
Auto-detects installed AI tools (claude, codex, aider, cursor, openclaw) and registers them as agents with default command templates and roles.

Example:
```bash
agentplan init
# Detected: claude ✓, codex ✓, aider ✗, cursor ✗, openclaw ✓
```

### `agentplan version`
Prints CLI version.

### `agentplan create <title> [--ticket ...] [--notes ...]`
Creates a project with slug derived from title.
- `--ticket` (repeatable): seed tickets in order
- `--notes`: optional project note

### `agentplan ticket add <project> <title>`
Adds a ticket to project.
- `--depends`: CSV list of ticket numbers
- `--priority`: high|medium|low|none
- `--tag`: comma-separated tags (use `role:<name>` for routing)
- `--due`: YYYY-MM-DD due date
- `--desc`: description text
- Rejects circular dependencies. Validates role tags against registered roles.

### `agentplan ticket done <project> <ticket_id...>`
Marks one or more tickets as `done`. Fires on-complete hooks. Auto-completes project when all tickets are done/skipped.

### `agentplan ticket block <project> <ticket_id>`
Marks ticket as `blocked`. Requires `--reason`.

### `agentplan ticket fail <project> <ticket_id>`
Marks ticket as `failed`. Requires `--reason`.

### `agentplan ticket review <project> <ticket_id>`
Marks ticket as `needs-review`. Requires `--reason`.

### `agentplan ticket start <project> <ticket_id>`
Marks ticket as `in-progress`.

### `agentplan ticket skip <project> <ticket_id...>`
Marks one or more tickets as `skipped`.

### `agentplan ticket edit <project> <ticket_id>`
Updates ticket properties: `--title`, `--priority`, `--tag`, `--due`, `--desc`.

### `agentplan next [project] [--tag TAG]`
Shows actionable tickets. Auto-reaps expired claims before returning results.
- Filters by tag if provided
- Respects dependency graph and priority ordering

### `agentplan claim <project> [--agent NAME] [--tag TAG] [--timeout MINUTES]`
Atomically claims next unblocked ticket using SQLite BEGIN IMMEDIATE.
- `--timeout`: claim expires after N minutes (enables auto-reap)
- `--agent`: attribution
- `--tag`: filter by tag

### `agentplan reap <project>`
Reclaims tickets with expired claim timeouts back to pending state.

### `agentplan status [project] [--format ...]`
Shows project status. Formats: `full` (default), `compact` (~50 tokens), `json`.

### `agentplan role add <name> [--description TEXT]`
Creates a role. Roles constrain ticket tags and agent routing.

### `agentplan role list`
Lists all registered roles.

### `agentplan role remove <name>`
Deletes a role.

### `agentplan role update <name> [--name NEW] [--description TEXT]`
Updates a role's name or description.

### `agentplan agent add <name> --command 'cmd {ticket}' --roles role1,role2 [--priority N]`
Registers an agent with a command template and assigned roles.
- Command template must contain a placeholder: `{ticket}`, `{{ticket}}`, `{project}`, `{{project}}`, `{ticket_id}`, or `{{ticket_id}}`
- `--roles`: comma-separated role names (must exist)
- `--priority`: lower number = higher priority for routing (default 0)

### `agentplan agent list`
Lists registered agents with roles and command templates.

### `agentplan agent remove <name>`
Removes an agent.

### `agentplan agent update <name> [--command ...] [--roles ...] [--priority N]`
Updates agent properties.

### `agentplan route <project> <ticket_id> [--terminal] [--default-agent NAME]`
Routes a ticket to the matching agent based on role tags.
- Matches ticket's `role:*` tag to agent roles
- Returns agent with highest priority (lowest number)
- `--terminal`: spawn the agent in a visible terminal window
- `--default-agent`: fallback if no role match

### `agentplan hook add <project> --event on-complete --type command|webhook|chain --target '...'`
Adds an event hook to a project.
- `--event`: currently `on-complete`
- `--type`: `command` (shell), `webhook` (HTTP POST), `chain` (agent chain)
- `--target`: command string, URL, or chain command
- Command targets support placeholders: `{ticket}`, `{project}`, `{ticket_id}`
- Hooks fire after DB commit (post-commit safety)

### `agentplan hook list <project>`
Lists hooks for a project.

### `agentplan hook remove <project> <hook_id>`
Removes a hook.

### `agentplan chain <project> [--default-agent NAME]`
Runs the sequential chain controller: picks next ticket → routes → spawns agent → monitors → repeats.

### `agentplan spawn-terminal <project> <ticket_id>`
Spawns agent in a visible terminal window for a specific ticket.

### `agentplan auto-tag <project> <ticket_id>`
Uses a configured AI tool to classify an untagged ticket into a role.

### `agentplan depend <project> <ticket_id> --on <id_csv>`
Adds dependencies. Rejects circular dependencies.

### `agentplan undepend <project> <ticket_id> --on <id>`
Removes a dependency.

### `agentplan subtask add/done/list <project> <ticket_id>`
Lightweight checklists within tickets.

### `agentplan search <query>`
Full-text search across all projects.

### `agentplan history <project> <ticket_id>`
Shows full audit trail for a ticket.

### `agentplan dashboard [--port PORT] [--open] [--stop]`
Launches web dashboard (requires Flask: `pip install agentplan[dashboard]`).
- **Home**: Mission Control with project cards and progress rings
- **Project View**: 6-column Kanban (Todo, In Progress, Blocked, Needs Review, Failed, Done)
- **Agents Page**: Configure agents, assign roles, auto-detected tools panel
- **Activity Feed**: Real-time SSE audit log
- **Controls**: Start Work / Stop buttons for chain controller
- **Review Panel**: Mark Done / Retry / Skip for failed tickets
- Dashboard validates state transitions (same rules as CLI)

## Ticket state machine

Valid states: `pending`, `in-progress`, `done`, `blocked`, `failed`, `needs-review`, `skipped`

Valid transitions:
```
pending → in-progress
in-progress → done, blocked, failed, needs-review, pending
blocked → pending, in-progress
failed → pending, in-progress
needs-review → pending, in-progress
```

Invalid transitions are rejected with an error message showing allowed transitions.

## Data model

### `projects`
- `id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT`
- `slug TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE`
- `title TEXT NOT NULL`
- `status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'active'`
- `notes TEXT`
- `created_at TEXT NOT NULL`
- `updated_at TEXT NOT NULL`

### `tickets`
- `id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT`
- `project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `num INTEGER NOT NULL`
- `title TEXT NOT NULL`
- `status TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'pending'`
- `depends_on TEXT DEFAULT '[]'`
- `priority TEXT DEFAULT 'none'`
- `tags TEXT DEFAULT '[]'`
- `description TEXT`
- `due_date TEXT`
- `claimed_by TEXT`
- `claimed_at TEXT`
- `claim_timeout INTEGER`
- `notes TEXT`
- `created_at TEXT NOT NULL`
- `completed_at TEXT`

### `roles`
- `id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT`
- `name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE`
- `description TEXT`

### `agents`
- `id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT`
- `name TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE`
- `command_template TEXT NOT NULL`
- `priority INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0`

### `agent_roles`
- `agent_id INTEGER REFERENCES agents(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `role_id INTEGER REFERENCES roles(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`

### `hooks`
- `id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT`
- `project_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES projects(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `event TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'on-complete'`
- `hook_type TEXT NOT NULL`
- `target TEXT NOT NULL`

### `ticket_history`
- `id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT`
- `ticket_id INTEGER NOT NULL REFERENCES tickets(id) ON DELETE CASCADE`
- `old_state TEXT`
- `new_state TEXT NOT NULL`
- `agent TEXT`
- `reason TEXT`
- `created_at TEXT NOT NULL`

### `attachments`
- `id`, `project_id`, `ticket_id`, `label`, `path`, `url`, `notes`, `created_at`

### `log`
- `id`, `project_id`, `ticket_id`, `entry`, `created_at`

### `subtasks`
- `id`, `ticket_id`, `title`, `status`, `created_at`

## Exit codes

- `0`: successful command
- `1`: empty results (no tickets, no projects)
- `2`: argument/validation/runtime errors

## Output formats

- `full`: human-readable board with icons (✓ ○ ⏳ ⛔ ✗)
- `compact`: single line, ~50 tokens, optimized for LLM context
- `json`: machine-readable

## Practical agent workflow examples

### Example 1: Setup with roles
```bash
agentplan init
agentplan role add coding
agentplan role add research
agentplan agent add codex --command 'codex exec --skip-git-repo-check -m gpt-5 "{ticket}"' --roles coding --priority 1
agentplan agent add claude --command 'claude --print "{ticket}"' --roles research --priority 2
```

### Example 2: Autonomous build loop
```bash
# Builder cron (every 10 min)
NEXT=$(agentplan next myproject --format compact)
[ -z "$NEXT" ] && exit 0
agentplan claim myproject --agent builder --timeout 30
# ... do work ...
agentplan ticket done myproject $ID --agent builder
```

### Example 3: QA review loop
```bash
# QA cron (every 10 min, offset)
agentplan status myproject --format json | jq '.tickets[] | select(.status=="done")'
# ... review changes ...
agentplan ticket add myproject "Bug: missing error handling" --priority high
```

### Example 4: Event-driven chaining
```bash
agentplan hook add myproject --event on-complete --type command --target 'agentplan claim myproject --agent next-agent'
# Now every completed ticket triggers the next agent automatically
```

## Notes for automation

- Project argument accepts slug or numeric id
- Ticket arguments use per-project ticket number (`num`), not raw row id
- Role tags use `role:<name>` format (e.g., `role:coding`)
- Agent command templates must contain `{ticket}` or variant placeholder
- `--roles` accepts comma-separated values (e.g., `--roles coding,research`)
- Hooks fire after DB commit for data integrity
- Dashboard validates same state transitions as CLI
- For robust scripts, parse JSON mode from `status`
